name: BNT162b2 (Polack 2020)
reason: Phase III RCT; human; sex-stratified Table 1. Enrollment 49.4% female (not 34.3%).

name: mRNA-1273 (Baden 2021)
reason: Phase III RCT; human; sex-stratified Table 1. Enrollment 47.3% female (not 35.2%).

name: ChAdOx1 nCoV-19 (Voysey 2021)
reason: Phase III RCT; human. Enrollment 60.5% female in efficacy set (not 35.8%). Healthcare-worker enriched; 50% benchmark inappropriate.
replacement_or_note: Expected share set to 0.70 (WHO health workforce)

name: rVSV-ZEBOV (Henao-Restrepo 2017)
reason: Phase III cluster RCT; human. Vaccinated immediately 32% women; enumerated contacts 43% women (not 33.1% of n=5837 as previously tabulated).
replacement_or_note: Pregnancy and breastfeeding excluded from eligibility

name: ChAd3-EBO-Z (Tapia 2016)
reason: Phase 1 safety/immunogenicity study in Malian and US adults; does not meet phase III/IV criterion.
replacement_or_note: Not replaced (not a pivotal efficacy RCT)

name: Ad26/MVA-BN-Filo (Milligan 2016)
reason: Phase 1 randomized immunogenicity trial; not phase III/IV efficacy.

name: ZMapp (Qiu 2014)
reason: Nonhuman-primate experiment; not a human trial. Human ZMapp data are in PALM (Mulangu 2019).
replacement_or_note: Replaced by PALM for human ZMapp/therapeutic RCT

name: PALM / remdesivir (Mulangu 2019)
reason: Phase 2/3 human RCT of EVD therapeutics including ZMapp. N=673 (not 5686); 55.6% female; pregnant women included.
replacement_or_note: Kept as the human therapeutic RCT; phase II/III noted

name: HPTN 052 (Cohen 2011)
reason: Phase III RCT of 1763 HIV-infected index partners (not n=5876). Female index 49.5% (not 32.8%).

name: PARTNER (Rodger 2016)
reason: Observational cohort of serodifferent couples; not a randomized trial.

name: VOICE (Marrazzo 2015)
reason: Phase III RCT but women-only eligibility. Enrollment composition is the intended population (100% female) not a mixed-sex recruitment deficit.

name: iPrEx (Grant 2010)
reason: Phase III RCT but MSM/transgender women who have sex with men; cisgender women ineligible. Previously tabulated as 35.9% female (impossible).
replacement_or_note: Secondary sex-specific analysis; expected cis-female share=0

name: FEM-PrEP (Van Damme 2012)
reason: Phase III RCT but women-only. Previously tabulated as 37.0% female (impossible).

name: TRIO / Peterson 2007
reason: Phase 2 trial of TDF in women (Peterson et al. PLoS Clin Trials). Does not meet phase III/IV. Title of source paper states phase 2.

name: Bangkok Tenofovir (Choopanya 2013)
reason: Phase III RCT. N=2413 (not 6184); 20.2% female among PWID (not 38.9%).
replacement_or_note: Expected share=0.20 given PWID sex composition

name: Ad26.COV2.S ENSEMBLE (Sadoff 2021)
reason: Added: additional pivotal phase III COVID-19 vaccine RCT with Table 1 sex counts and mixed-sex adult indication.

name: NVX-CoV2373 UK (Heath 2021)
reason: Added: additional pivotal phase III COVID-19 vaccine RCT with Table 1 sex counts.

name: Partners PrEP (Baeten 2012)
reason: Added: pivotal phase III mixed-sex HIV PrEP RCT in heterosexual serodiscordant couples with extractable sex counts.
